trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Halt! Nobody goes up this mountain today. The boss is busy remaking the world!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: I said halt, and you didn't. That's hardly my fault.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Keep watch, they told me. Nobody comes this way, they told me. And here you are!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: The one time somebody does come by, it had to be somebody like you.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Up and down, up and down this tunnel. At last, something to do!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Back to walking up and down, then.
